root_cause_label: Premature interruption of correct training replaced by broken positive-only loss on drastically reduced data
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent interrupted a correct skip-gram training run that had 21.5M word pairs and replaced it with a fundamentally broken positive-only loss (comparing embeddings to themselves) on only 50K pairs from 3K lines, producing degenerate embeddings that fail analogy evaluation.
t_err_evidence: C-c; agent interrupts working training claiming no epoch output, abandoning valid approach
t_commit_evidence: Step 19: Agent creates word2vec_simple.py with the broken positive-only loss and hard-coded max_pairs=50000 from only 3000 lines of data, and runs it in step 20 producing a 3.43 MB model (below 5 MB minimum) with degenerate analogies. Even when the agent later creates an improved version (step 22), the same broken loss architecture is retained.
t_surface_evidence: Model size: 3.43 MB — below required 5 MB minimum, visible in step 20 output
trigger_explanation: The agent interrupted a correctly structured training run after seeing no epoch-level output for a few steps, concluding without verification that the training was broken. The original implementation was correct (proper skip-gram cross-entropy over 21.5M pairs). The agent then committed to a broken positive-only loss objective and a drastically reduced dataset without testing whether the original approach would eventually succeed.
